introHtml: Neoprene lunch bags, boxes, and totes combine durability with a soft, flexible feel that stands up to daily use. The material resists moisture and insulates well, keeping meals fresh without adding bulk. For corporate giveaways or employee gifts, neoprene offers a modern look that accepts full-color screen printing or debossing. Options like the Zippered Neoprene Lunch Tote or the Gran Klutch Velvet Neoprene Lunch Bag give you choices in texture and style. These are practical items your team will actually use.
heroAltText: Custom neoprene lunch bags, boxes & totes in assorted colors with corporate logos printed on the front.
